column3: NASB moves “salvation” and renders it “for security.”
“Peace peace” is rendered “perfect peace,” and “inclination” as “mind.”
“Yah Yahweh” is rendered “GOD the LORD,” and NASB adds “we have.”
“Zeal of a people” is rendered “Your zeal for the people,” and “they will behold” as “They see.”
“We bring to remembrance” is rendered “we confess.”
“Not they fall” is rendered “Nor were … born.”
“My corpse” is rendered “Their corpses,” and “dew of lights” as “dew of the dawn”; “will make fall” becomes “will give birth to.”
